newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates dip despite operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates dip despite operation.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates dipped at close on Sunday as banks were unsure about the liquididty status, dealers said.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan mopped up about one billion rupees in an open market operation but could not help firm up overnight that fell from eight percent at open to two percent at close, one dealer said.
The dealers said the rates might remain bearish as the market would open liquid on Monday. - Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
